apps.name: VoltTune
apps.subtitle: Scooter tuning via Bluetooth
apps.versionDescription: Initial release. Supports Ninebot, Xiaomi and Navee scooters. NinebotCrypto encrypted pairing, Sport Mode, Zero Start, Speed Limit, Panic Button, Controller Info.
apps.localizedDescription:
VoltTune connects to your Ninebot, Xiaomi or Navee electric scooter via Bluetooth and unlocks its full potential.

Features:
• Remove speed limits up to hardware maximum
• Sport Mode — full motor power
• Zero Start — instant throttle from standstill
• Eco Mode — extend battery range
• Cruise Control
• Panic Button — configure a scooter button to instantly cap speed
• Lock & Alarm
• Controller & firmware info
• Accent color themes + Rainbow mode

Supports 89 models across Ninebot/Segway, Xiaomi/Mi and Navee.

For use on private property only.

permissions.usageDescription: VoltTune uses Bluetooth to connect to and tune your electric scooter.
